annotations.title: B2B corporate email deliverability, disposable/burner filter, DoH MX

description: [0.004000 USDC via x402] Verifies a single email or batch of up to 20 emails via RFC 5322 + IDNA lowercase normalization, role-inbox and 90+ disposable burner domain rejection, primary-first RFC 8427 DNS-over-HTTPS MX provider classification (Google Workspace, Gmail Consumer, Microsoft 365, Apple iCloud / Corporate, Proofpoint, Mimecast, Cisco Secure Email, Broadcom Symantec, Barracuda, AWS SES, Cloudflare Email Routing, Proton Mail, Zoho Mail, Fastmail, Custom), RFC 7489 organizational-apex DMARC fallback, and IANA-bootstrapped RDAP apex domain age (< 30 days fraud flag).

email.description: Single email address to verify (e.g., 'tim@apple.com'). Provide either 'email' or 'emails'.

emails.description: Batch of 1 to 20 email addresses to verify in a single request.
